errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the colors for the years 2022 and 2023. According to the legend, 2022 is represented by blue bars and 2023 by orange bars.
The bar for month I in 2022 reaches a value of approximately 101,000, not 90,000.
The description incorrectly appends a percentage sign to the index values (e.g., 90 000%). The y-axis represents index values, not percentages of this magnitude.
The bar for month XII in 2024 reaches a value of approximately 112,000, not 120,000.
The bar for month VI in 2023 has a height of approximately 98,000, not 105,000.
The bar for month VIII in 2022 has a height of approximately 82,000, not 95,000.
The description fails to mention that the chart is a grouped bar chart, which is a key structural feature for comparing the years within each month.
